latest_rss.summary: 本周，一宗号称“世纪大劫案”的案件刷新了有史以来金融盗窃案的损失记录。全球最大加密货币交易所币安（Binance）遭遇史上最严重黑客攻击，黑客盗走约63亿美元的加密货币。为阻止资金进一步流失，该平台一度暂停客户提现服务。周日（11月1日），币安宣布，将逐步恢复用户提现服务，并表示第一批提现服务现已在比特币网络上开放。更令人意想不到的是，FBI表示，已经确认幕后黑手为朝鲜黑客组织“TraderTraitor”。从出于报复目的的数据破坏，到大规模窃取虚拟货币，再到各种形式的网络入侵，朝鲜近年来似乎拥有了一支隐秘而强大的网络攻击力量。外界认为，朝鲜通过这些行动获取的巨额收益，主要用于资助朝鲜的军事项目。

latest_rss.title: AI Lessons From Russia’s War in Ukraine
latest_rss.summary:
Executive Summary:




Chinese military writers studying the use of artificial intelligence (AI) in Russia’s war in Ukraine have concluded that its decisive value lies in shortening the kill chain rather than in fully autonomous weapons.



In their reading, AI plays four roles: turning sensor data into targets, accelerating planning and command, keeping drones on target when jamming cuts the link, and mass-produced propaganda and deep-fakes.



Each of these roles rests on the combat data, computing power, chips, and AI models that the PRC wishes to control domestically. Starlink’s wartime restrictions and Russia’s reliance on U.S. chips serve as warnings.



The People’s Liberation Army (PLA) is turning these lessons into AI planning systems, unmanned units, and procurement of domestic large language models (LLMs). Some concede that PLA’s AI is still used mainly for auxiliary tasks, with these authors acknowledging that doctrine lags technological advancements.
